marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 10 to 15 knots increasing to northwest 25 late
overnight and to northwest 30 Friday morning. Showers beginning this evening changing to rain overnight
then to showers Friday evening. Visibility as low as 1 mile in
rain. <br/>

subsiding to 1 Friday evening.<br/>
